set.name: RtNotZ Investigator Expansion — scripted 1–10
set.description: Cards 1–10 of Unofficial Return to Night of the Zealot - Investigator Expansion, with their abilities written for the engine.

meta.set: Unofficial Return to Night of the Zealot - Investigator Expansion

_abilities.tooltip: After you successfully investigate: Place 1 ammo token on a Firearm asset you control.

meta.set: Unofficial Return to Night of the Zealot - Investigator Expansion

_abilities.tooltip: Spend 1 ammo: Fight. +2 [combat]. You may place 1 of your clues on your location for +2 damage.

meta.set: Unofficial Return to Night of the Zealot - Investigator Expansion

_abilities.tooltip: Place 1 of your clues on your location: Discard Cover Up.

meta.set: Unofficial Return to Night of the Zealot - Investigator Expansion

_abilities.tooltip: After you discover clues from a non-basic investigate action: look at the top 2 cards of the encounter deck.

meta.set: Unofficial Return to Night of the Zealot - Investigator Expansion

_abilities.tooltip: Exhaust and spend 1 book: the investigator testing a non-weakness treachery at your location gets +2 skill value.
Replenish 1 book token on Daisy's Tote Bag and ready it.

meta.set: Unofficial Return to Night of the Zealot - Investigator Expansion

_abilities.tooltip: The first time you draw an encounter card each round: move 1 horror to Daisy Walker, or draw an additional encounter card.

options.label: Move 1 horror from The Necronomicon to Daisy Walker

meta.set: Unofficial Return to Night of the Zealot - Investigator Expansion
Unofficial Return to Night of the Zealot - Investigator Expansion

_abilities.tooltip: At the end of your turn: place 1 resource here for each action you spent beyond 3 this round.

meta.set: Unofficial Return to Night of the Zealot - Investigator Expansion

_abilities.tooltip: When you would play a card: increase its cost by 2 and remove 1 resource from Hospital Debts.

meta.set: Unofficial Return to Night of the Zealot - Investigator Expansion

_abilities.tooltip: When a chaos token is sealed on a card you control: deal 1 damage (negative modifier) or discover 1 clue (positive or neutral).

options.label: Release a token sealed on Agnes Baker
